description: This file defines the AppListAdapter class, which is an ArrayAdapter used for displaying a list of AppEntry objects in an Android application that supports multiple displays. It handles inflating list item views, populating them with app icons and labels, and managing its data set.

classes.name: AppListAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for displaying a list of available apps, managing the creation and population of list item views.

methods.name: AppListAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a context and sets up the LayoutInflater.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set with a new list of AppEntry objects.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Provides a view for each item in the dataset, inflating the layout if necessary and populating it with the app's icon and label.
